visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a wide shot of a young woman sleeping peacefully in a large bed under a grey, textured duvet. The room is softly lit by a bedside lamp, creating a warm, cozy atmosphere with a wooden ladder visible in the background. (2) Close-up shots focus on the woman's hands as she wears multiple gold rings and adjusts a white, fuzzy robe. (3) The woman is then seen sitting on a rustic wooden stool, carefully placing long, dry reeds into a glass bottle containing liquid on a wooden surface. (4) She sits comfortably on her bed, leaning against the headboard, and writes in a journal with a grey pen while a small golden bottle rests on the ledge behind her. (5) In a tender moment, she sits on the floor beside a grey laptop, smiling as she pets a large, sleek grey Weimaraner dog. (6) A finger is shown circling a golden glass bottle of Guerlain skincare oil on a lit shelf. (7) The woman holds the bottle, shakes it gently, and begins her skincare routine. She applies drops of the golden oil into her palm, rubs her hands together to warm the product, and then presses her palms against her face, massaging her cheeks and forehead with upward motions. (8) Detailed close-ups highlight the application of the oil as she uses a dropper directly on her skin and continues to massage her face and jawline, showing her glowing complexion. (9) She smiles warmly while holding the product near her face. (10) The scene transitions to the woman performing various yoga-style stretches and deep breathing exercises on a white rug in the bedroom. (11) The video concludes by returning to the initial scene of her sleeping soundly in bed under the warm lighting.
